tool_args.rationale: The observations establish saturation and gradient dependence, but leave a genuine ambiguity between a static saturating law and a two-layer transfer mechanism. Fine trajectory observations can distinguish their temporal behavior before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a gradient-dependent saturating snapshot law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot curve and two gradient observations do not uniquely identify the two-hop mechanism or its temporal behavior.
It ignores the substantial gradient dependence revealed by the open-branch probe.
The nuisance measurement would not resolve the mechanism.
